fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Front Driveway; Walkway; Dense Vegetation; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area
fr.considerations: Dense Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Limited Rear Access; Single Access Point
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders confirm the correct property from the road.
• Trim vegetation along the driveway to maintain clear vehicle passage from the street to the residence.
• Cut back dense vegetation growing close to the main residence to allow responders to move around the exterior walls.
• Cut back dense vegetation growing close to the detached structure to allow responders to reach and work around it.
• Keep a clear walking path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings without pushing through vegetation.
• Mark or unlock any gate providing rear access so responders are not delayed reaching the back of the property.
• Keep the walkway to the front door clear of vegetation overhang so responders can move quickly to the entrance.

wildfire.conditions: Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Large Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Limited Vegetation Separation; Vegetation Along Driveway; Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Mixed Vegetation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that extend directly over or within a few feet of the roofline and walls.
• Thin the cluster of large trees nearest the structure to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants from the base of the large trees closest to the house.
• Clear shrubs and brush growing along both sides of the driveway.
• Keep the ground beneath scattered trees around the structure free of dead leaves, needles, and fallen branches.
• Separate shrubs growing directly against or touching any side of the structure by moving or removing them.
• Thin scattered trees on the approach to the structure so vehicles can pass and turn without obstruction.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from the area immediately surrounding the structure.
• Cut back vegetation along the driveway edges so overhanging branches do not block vehicle clearance.
• Create a continuous open gap of bare ground or short-cut grass between the structure walls and the nearest shrubs or trees.
